decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen has repeatedly won the Deutsches Brotinstitut gold medal and is a flagship seasonal product the bakery actively promotes, so dropping it is very unlikely.
Unlike the other rye breads launched in 2023, the dark barley malt rye bread survived the 2024 range cleanup and still has its own page, which suggests it has found a stable place in the range.
The marzipan stollen is a classic seasonal product that complements the award-winning raisin stollen, has kept its own page for two seasons, and costs little to keep in the Christmas range.
